scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have to got a job to complete the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
很抱歉，您必须先完成一个任务才能参加此活动。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I am sorry but you have already completed the event.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
很抱歉，您已经完成过此活动了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Greetings fellow lively human.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
你好，活泼的人类朋友。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Halloween is upon us and it is almost time to adventure out into places few dare go.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
万圣节就要到了，是时候去那些鲜有人敢涉足的地方冒险了。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Trick or treat, which do you prefer?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
特里克还是糖果，您更喜欢哪一个？

scripts.text: Trick
scripts.translation: 特里克

scripts.text: Treat
scripts.translation: 糖果

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a trick. Why don't you go pick a treat now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
很抱歉，您已经领取过特里克了。为什么不去领个糖果呢？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Give me a min...
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
请稍等...

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Here is your treat. Your Base EXP has been slightly increased.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
这是您的糖果。您的基础经验值略有提升。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I hope you enjoy your trick and Happy Halloween!
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
希望您享受您的特里克，万圣节快乐！

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I'm sorry but you have already had a treat. Why don't you go pick a trick now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
很抱歉，您已经领取过糖果了。为什么不去领个特里克呢？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Great! This shall be so much fun.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
太好了！这会非常有趣。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Did you get the items I requested or do you need to see the list again?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
您拿到我要求的物品了吗？还是需要再看一遍清单？

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I will be sending you on a scavenger hunt for items.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我将派您去进行一场物品搜寻。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Bring back all the necessary items, and I will create you a treat.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
带回所有必要的物品，我会为您制作一份糖果。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Not just any normal treat either that you can eat, but it is something you can wear on your head.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
不过，这可不是那种能吃的普通糖果，而是可以戴在头上的东西。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
But with all things made, some items are required first.
The list:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
但制作任何物品都需要先准备材料。
清单如下：
1 顶帽子，
30 个南瓜，以及
20 块黑色布料

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Hurry along now.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
快去吧。

scripts.text: Got'em
scripts.translation: 拿到了

scripts.text: Don't Have
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: See List
scripts.translation: 查看清单

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
You don't have enough items. Come back when you do.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
您的物品不足。请准备好后再来。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Good job! I hope you are happy with your item.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
做得好！希望您喜欢这份物品。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Enjoy the rest of your Halloween.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
祝您万圣节快乐。

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
Go back out and search for them. Would you like to view the list?
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
快出去寻找它们吧。需要查看清单吗？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text:
[Hallows' Eve Event]
I require the following items:
1 Hat,
30 Pumpkin, and
20 Black Piece of Cloth.
scripts.translation:
[万圣夜活动]
我需要以下物品：
1 顶帽子，
30 个南瓜，以及
20 块黑色布料。
